title: Screen GHL data for planted instructions; shared GHL rate budget per client

title: Agent server: scripted model for staging (no AI key or cost)
GHL agency grant refresh can race between processes
description: agencyToken() refreshes and stores the grant without a lock. With the web app (several serverless instances) and the agent server both refreshing near expiry, GHL's rotating refresh token can be used twice and one refresh fails, possibly breaking the connection. Add a compare-and-swap or lease in the control DB around the refresh.

title: Agent server follow-ups from PR #56 review
description: Evict idle per-client controllers (memory grows with clients opened); bound or re-check long /stream connections after access is lost; a member with no access to the active client gets 401 not 403 (chat may loop to sign-in); a control-DB outage in getSession returns a raw 500; verify Vercel external-rewrite streaming/timeout for SSE on staging (next start has a 30s proxy timeout: set experimental.proxyTimeout or heartbeats if self-hosting the web app); pin base image by digest.
notes:
Also: openers map (per client, session contexts) only shrinks when a check fails.
Round 4: stream re-check now guarded for any SSE response (done). Each check costs about 3-4 control-DB reads per open stream every 5s; consider a short per-session cache if many streams stay open.
Round 5 minor: readCapped should cancel an oversized body; GET forwards host requestContext (session row id) in the internal URL query, send a smaller value.
